name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created example.py, and successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs API. The output.mp3 file (44KB, 2.77 seconds, 44100 Hz, 128 kbps, mono) was verified with ffprobe as a proper MPEG ADTS layer III audio file.
deviations: The quickstart's final step calls `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. In the sandbox, MPV was not available and could not be installed (no sudo privileges). I replaced `play(audio)` with writing the audio stream to `output.mp3`, which still fulfills the promised outcome of generating an audio file from text. The core API authentication and text-to-speech request matched the quickstart exactly.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
